title: Haldensee Tannheim
highlights: Crystal-clear swimming lake boasting excellent drinking-water quality
Modern lido with solar-heated outdoor pool and sunbathing lawn
Popular area for stand-up paddleboarding, rowing, and fishing
Beautiful lakeside promenade with unobstructed views of the Tannheim peaks
kurzbeschreibung: Haldensee is a crystal-clear natural swimming lake in the Tannheimer Tal, combining bathing enjoyment with panoramic hikes.
beschreibung:
Swimming Pleasures and Mountain Scenery at Haldensee

The picturesque Haldensee is situated in the broad high valley of the Tannheimer Tal at over 1,120 metres above sea level between Grän and Nesselwängle. With its outstanding water quality and pleasant summer temperatures, it is a cherished meeting place for water sports enthusiasts and those seeking relaxation.

Lakeside Leisure Activities

Alongside the solar-heated open-air lido on the lakeside promenade, the lake provides prime conditions for sailing, rowing, stand-up paddleboarding, and angling. Flat walking and cycling routes run along the shore, commanding expansive views of the distinctive summits of Rote Flüh and Gimpel.
